name: Mini camera
description: A tiny camera that fits in a CubeSat. Cheap, but the pictures are not very detailed.

name: Wide camera
description: Takes color pictures of large areas.

name: High-resolution camera
description: Sees small details, like a telescope pointed down. Makes a LOT of data.

name: Infrared spectrometer
description: Splits light into colors to find out what things are made of, such as water ice or gases in an atmosphere.

name: Radar sounder
description: Sends radio waves that pass through dust, clouds and even underground ice.

name: Magnetometer
description: Measures magnetic fields, which tell us what is happening deep inside a planet.

name: Particle & radiation detector
description: Counts the charged particles and radiation around the spacecraft.

name: Microwave radiometer
description: Sees deep below the cloud tops of giant planets.

name: Laser altimeter
description: Bounces a laser off the ground to measure the height of mountains and craters.

name: Dust analyzer
description: Catches tiny dust and ice grains, for example from the plumes of an icy moon, and finds out what they are made of.
